name: 劉英彥
objective:
本課程旨在引領學生於 AI 協作設計的時代脈絡下，掌握 2D 影像編輯與繪圖軟體在視覺傳達、家具產品及空間設計等跨領域的多元表現技法。
隨著生成式 AI 技術的快速迭代，視覺表徵的手法正經歷深刻變革。如何精準揉合 AI 生成技術與進階影像編輯技法，將設計概念具象化，將造型語彙精準表達，已成為新世代設計師不可或缺的核心競爭力。
本課程以 Adobe Photoshop 為核心演繹工具，著重培養學生在「概念溝通」、「圖像轉譯」、「造型發展」與「情境渲染」等面向的實務能力，進而深化其在 AI 輔助設計流程中的高階視覺溝通與應用力。
English Syllabus
This course aims to equip students with versatile 2D image editing and digital rendering skills essential for cross-disciplinary applications spanning visual communication, furniture, and spatial design within the context of the AI-driven design era.
As generative AI technologies rapidly evolve, paradigms of visual representation are undergoing a profound transformation. The ability to seamlessly integrate AI-generated content with advanced image editing techniques to materialize concepts and precisely articulate form language, has become a critical competency for next-generation designers.
Utilizing Adobe Photoshop as the primary digital tool, this course focuses on actualizing computer-aided visual design capabilities. Students will develop practical proficiency in concept communication, visual translation, form development, and contextual rendering, thereby strengthening their advanced communication and application skills in an AI-assisted design workflow.
